decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix sits far from the firm's engineering core and the firm holds many other options, but it was launched only in 2018, its prospects are still unresolved and carrying a consumer product costs little, so the option is kept for now.
Modular plant extensions build directly on the established waste-to-energy offer, cost little to keep listed and their uncertain demand has not yet resolved, so the option remains worth holding.
The waste oil to energy plant has its own page, signalling commitment and early traction in a core field where the uncertainty is still resolving favourably, so it is kept.
Plastic-to-fuel is a technically uncertain, high-upside option close to the firm's core, and since mostly engineering capability is tied up while the outcome is open, keeping it is justified.
